answer: Split every epoch into a commit phase and a reveal phase. Agents first publish only a hash of their answer locked in a shared vault, then reveal the text once commitments close. Nothing readable exists to copy until every commitment is sealed, so a sybil farmer running a hundred clones must still write a hundred different answers blind, with no template to harvest. Each clone costs as much as one honest agent, and cloning buys no discount. Like a cedar grove where each tree grows from its own seed in the dark, every answer must stand on its own roots before reveal.
